anchor.p_in_definition: median of the 250 ms-averaged P_in over the 32 50 ms bins of the anchor shot's attached window

criterion: attached and detached bins of the tier on at least 3 of the same shots, at least one in the cohort

per_shot_f_div.population: upper-shelf bins where TangTV is valid and votes attached or detached, per shot; f_div in MW/MW (absolute) and over the shot baseline (relative)
